description: Derived Capability -> Effective Performance. Per-capability sensitivity multipliers for current fighter state. Values are initial candidates, not balanced.

formula.note: effective_d = derived_d * product(factor_k_d), each factor clamped to [factor_floor, 1.0]

stamina.note: deficit = clamp((plateau - stamina) / (plateau - floor), 0, 1); factor = 1 - max_loss * deficit^curve_exponent. Flat at or above plateau; accelerates as stamina falls.

body_damage.note: factor = 1 - max_loss * (damage / scale)^curve_exponent. Left/right parts resolve to lead/rear through stance.

stamina_economy.note: Body damage and weight stress act on the stamina system itself, not on individual capabilities.

interval_recovery.note: Between-round recovery, referenced by docs/design/23_round_structure_and_judging.md. Never reaches full.

weight_stress.note: Weight stress mainly acts through the stamina economy and durability. The global penalty is deliberately small to avoid double counting.

rule_familiarity.note: Low familiarity also degrades plan quality and action selection. That effect lives in the plan-execution layer, not here.

effective_durability.note: Not one of the 17 Derived Capabilities. Produced by this layer and consumed by finish resolution.
